<!--
diag_05_mining_by_region.qmd -- decision-ready report (see code/1_remote_sensing/explainer.md's
diag_NN_* convention). Split 2026-11-06 from a single EE-authenticated .qmd into this
presentation-only document + diag_05_data_prep.R, which does the EE auth, downloads, and figure/
table generation. Run diag_05_data_prep.R in RStudio first; this file only reads what it writes to
outputs/figures/diag_05/ and outputs/tables/diag_05/ (no rgee, no EE session, no internet needed to
render). See explainer.md for the full rationale and the rgee gotchas the prep script works around.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9)
pacman::p_load(here, tidyverse, scales, knitr)

fig_dir <- here("outputs", "figures", "diag_05")
tbl_dir <- here("outputs", "tables", "diag_05")

meta <- readRDS(here(tbl_dir, "diag05_meta.rds"))
embed_years <- meta$embed_years
overview_first_year <- meta$overview_first_year
latest_year <- max(embed_years)
first_year  <- min(embed_years)
```

## 1. Cumulative mining panel, by district

Same definition as `build_03_embedding_panel.R` / `explore_mining_vs_forest_type_app.js`: the
**union-to-date** of `mine_mask_ghana_c4_<yr>` (monotonically non-decreasing cumulative footprint),
not each year's raw independent classification. Built, pulled by district, and written to
`outputs/tables/mining_by_district.csv` / `mining_by_region.csv` by `diag_05_data_prep.R` -- see
that script for the EE/rgee side of this.

## 2. National total (sanity check)

District-level sum should match a direct national reduceRegion closely (small differences are
scale/edge-pixel rounding, not a bug).

```{r national-check}
read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "national_check.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = paste0("National cumulative mining through ", latest_year))
```

## 3. Distribution of region-level mining area, `r latest_year`

```{r region-hist}
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_region_hist.png"))
```

## 4. Region ranking, `r latest_year`

```{r region-bar}
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_region_bar.png"))
```

## 5. Region overview: level + growth together

Each bar's grey segment is the `r overview_first_year` level, the coloured segment is growth to
`r latest_year`, so bar length = current total and the split shows how much of that total is
pre-existing vs. new.

```{r region-overview-combined}
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_region_overview_combined.png"))
```

## 6. Mining increase by region, `r first_year` -> `r latest_year`

```{r region-increase-table}
read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "region_increase.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = paste0("Region-level mining increase, ", first_year, "-", latest_year))
```

```{r region-increase-bar}
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_region_increase_bar.png"))
```

## 7. Top 10 districts, `r latest_year`

Same idea one level down -- which individual districts actually drive the regional totals above.

```{r top10-districts-table}
read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "top10_districts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = paste0("Top 10 districts by cumulative mining area, ", latest_year))
```

```{r top10-districts-bar}
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_top10_districts_bar.png"))
```

## 8. Mining encroachment on protected areas, `r latest_year`

How much of each district's cumulative gold mining footprint falls inside a WDPA/WDOECM
**Designated** protected area (national parks, forest reserves, etc. -- "Proposed" sites excluded,
not yet legally protected).

```{r protected-areas-national, results='asis'}
pa_summary <- read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "national_pa_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cat(sprintf(
  "National: %.1f km2 (%.1f%%) of cumulative gold mining through %d falls inside a Designated protected area.\n",
  pa_summary$nat_mining_in_pa, pa_summary$pct_mining_in_pa, pa_summary$year))
```

```{r protected-areas-table}
read_csv(here(tbl_dir, "protected_overlap_top15.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = paste0(
    "Top 15 districts by gold mining area inside a Designated protected area, through ", latest_year))
```

```{r protected-areas-bar}
knitr::include_graphics(here(fig_dir, "fig_protected_areas_bar.png"))
```
